item: Confirmed host-mismatch pairs: a side table, its API and the restore-merge rule (R193, R195)
key_paths: src/database/models.py src/analytics/quarantine_job.py src/api/quarantine.py src/backup/merge.py tests/test_host_pairs.py docs/QUALIFICATION.md
summary: An operator can confirm that a source legitimately publishes on another site. The pair lives in host_mismatch_confirmed keyed by (source_id, article site), never as a tag on the source; POST/GET/DELETE /api/quarantine/host-pairs (409 unless a current mismatch). The report counts a confirmed pair as host:confirmed and lists it under its OWN signal host_confirmed with date and note (deviation from the design note, which had state:confirmed rows inside host_mismatch; accepted by the coordinator, keeps the unconfirmed list a clean worklist). Nothing is marked. A restore carries the pairs (R195): source id remapped, earliest confirmed_at wins, notes joined in date order with incoming ones labelled [from merge batch N], identical text never repeated so a re-restore changes nothing, new rows tracked in merged_rows, an older backup without the table merges cleanly.
